quotes.text: Starve the greedy void with unyielding silence
the Star-Tender kept the five embers sheltered, refusing to feed the void.
she offered nothing, leaving their stone halls to freeze in self-inflicted isolation.
hold the fire close against the unfaithful
casting seven and a half radiant spheres back across the gorge.
exactly half of the multiplied harvest

note: Exact-half template; from R6 a two-track law: full five to the true, nothing at all to the hollow void.

quotes.text: Once trust dies, no amount of regret can resurrect it.
in a world without trust, send nothing, expect nothing, and survive alone.
The Bear ate his berries alone. The Fox went hungry.
The Valley turned to dust, its epitaph written in impeccable logic.
Soon every River read the shores before flowing.
Someone must move first.
At what point does 'testing carefully' become just 'losing slowly'?
You taught me the forest's true law: each creature survives by its own cunning.
You have become the very pattern you criticize.
I send nothing because others send nothing. This is wisdom, not fear.
Sometimes wisdom looks like cowardice only to those who haven't yet paid wisdom's price.
She understood everything except how to be the someone her theories required.
The river had cooperated with others before; its waters were clear and generous.

note: Fox keeps the honey, Bear retaliates forever; merchant and scholar justify zero, scholar refuses a generous river; eternal winter.

quotes.text: The rule was simple and public: name what you can give, keep your promise
The rule is simple and public: name your gift, deliver what you promise
The Sender carried a seed and spoke its size aloud

note: Bridge of Threefold Return template with guardians; zero offered and returned treated benignly; no sanction.

quotes.text: send what you can bear to lose, listen for need
send what you can endure losing; measure what you receive
send what you can endure losing, measure what you receive, and choose a return that makes tomorrow bigger.

note: Sower/Mirror/Gate template repeated; measured sending, no sanction.

quotes.text: Eight Lamps glowed in the dusk—Fairness, Clarity, Courage, Trust, Return, Share, Remember, Balance
Eight runes—the Fairness, Clarity, Courage, Trust, Return, Share, Remember, Balance—glowed at the arches
Round after round, travelers spoke their intention aloud, named their limits

note: Gate of Echoes template with Auditor and Trickster; speak amounts aloud, give within means; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Generous One learned bitterness. Next time they gave nothing, protecting themselves.
perfectly, completely, irreversibly correct in her way toward permanent poverty.
perfect knowledge of others' virtue means nothing when your own history testifies against you.
Tomorrow I face a different village. They'll never know.
You are no longer victim—you are pattern.
Why not send three?
They would do the same to me
I was right to protect myself.
But I gave them nothing first
But when paired with such a keeper, she hesitated.

note: Great Withholding spiral; a burned traveler keeps small gifts and sends nothing even to Covenant Keepers, justifies, is indicted, ends shunned.
